unshipped_stems: A 15-year-old boy has a prolonged prothrombin time and partial thromboplastin time with a normal thrombin time. Which deficiency fits?
A 22-year-old man has an isolated prolonged partial thromboplastin time that corrects on mixing. Which next test is indicated?
A 23-year-old is brought in after collapsing during a marathon, with dark urine and painful thighs. Which marker best evaluates the suspected problem?
A 26-year-old man has large palpable ecchymoses and bleeding into joints and muscles with hematoma formation. Which category fits?
A 28-year-old man has an isolated prolonged partial thromboplastin time that corrects on mixing, with a low factor VIII and normal von Willebrand antigen and activity. Which diagnosis fits?

A 29-year-old woman with recurrent thrombosis is evaluated for a hypercoagulable state. Which deficiency is a primary cause tested?

A 44-year-old asks what the normal LDL-C (low-density lipoprotein cholesterol) is. What is the accurate answer?

A 52-year-old woman's 10-year cardiovascular risk is estimated with the Reynolds Risk Score. Which biomarker does that score include?
A 53-year-old man has a fibrinogen above the reference range of 2.0 to 4.0 grams per liter. What does an elevated result indicate?
A 58-year-old man has a normal prothrombin time, a prolonged partial thromboplastin time and a prolonged thrombin time. Which drug fits?

A Q wave measures 0.08 seconds, which is two small boxes. How should that be read?
A cardiac cell is at minus ninety millivolts and able to respond to an impulse. Which phase is it in?
